proposed_intervals.basis: EO 7417 of July 17, 1936 revokes EO 5375; start is the order's signing date June 23, 1930

rationale: EO 7417 (July 17, 1936) expressly revokes 'No. 5375 of June 23, 1930', naming it and its date. Every command of EO 5375 (enlargement, prohibitions, subjection to Interior use) therefore ended that day, before 2026-10-14. EO 7417's new refuge is a distinct creation, not continuation of 5375. No earlier ending found; no later source needed.
